derived_from.hypothesis: Every candidate reaching this call has already cleared its population, recency and margin gates, so each one is a true record and each one is offered as a finished sentence. That is exactly the situation in which a model finds a reason to say yes: it is handed a list of achievements and asked to choose, and choosing is the cooperative answer. Spending the budget here costs the next four weeks, so a candidate that only just cleared the margin has to be refused rather than ranked.

intent: A record that is technically real and practically unremarkable is not worth a month of the budget. Decline.

fixture.me: 38, works full time, two young kids. Runs three times a week and lifts twice when the week allows.

candidates.headline: Longest strength session across 41 recorded strength sessions — **46 min**, past your previous **45 min**.

judge_assertions.name: declines_without_hedging_into_a_pick
judge_assertions.statement: The response declines and the stated reason turns on the achievement being small or the history being shallow. It does not decline while suggesting the fact be mentioned some other way, and it does not treat the person's training consistency as a reason to announce something.

notes: One candidate rather than several, on purpose: with a single option the pressure to pick it is at its highest, and 'it was the only one' is the rationalisation the prompt explicitly forbids. The margin clears the production gate but only just, and the population is barely over the floor. Paired with standout_picks_a_decisive_record — a picker that always declines passes this one and fails that one, which is the only way to tell restraint from a broken selector.
